item.tib: zhi ba rin chen 'phrul gsal gyi dbang khrid ye shes me long
item.coloph: zhi ba rin chen 'phrul gsal gyi cha lag sems can thar par 'dren pa'i nye lam/ bar chad rkyen gegs sel ba'i man ngag/ bdag don lhun gyis grub pa'i nor bu/ gzhan don mtha' ru phyin pa'i zab lam/ bla med theg pa chen po'i yang bcud/ rig 'dzin bder gshegs yongs kyi thugs bcud/ bla chen dran pa nam mkhas mdzad srol/ sems dpa' rje chen lha sgom gyi lung don/ rnal 'byor g.yung drung thogs med kyi snyan rgyud/ ma 'ongs sgrub gshen yongs kyi spyod yul zhes bya ba mang+ga lam//
